title: QuerySummary
description: Summarizes the current result window for a search surface (e.g. 'Products 1-12 of 43 for Water Sports'). Read-only from the frontend. Rather than reading three sibling components' state (search-box query, pagination page/pageSize/totalEntries, product-list count), it carries its own backend-computed aggregate so it has no cross-component coupling.

QuerySummaryState.title: QuerySummaryState
QuerySummaryState.description: The backend-computed aggregate for the current result window. Owned exclusively by the backend; the frontend must not mutate this directly.

query.description: The current query string. May be empty when the surface has no active query.

firstIndex.description: The 1-based index of the first result on the current page.

lastIndex.description: The 1-based index of the last result on the current page.

totalEntries.description: The total number of results across all pages.
